Class RouxChatMemory

java.lang.Object
org.roux.spring.RouxChatMemory
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.ai.chat.memory.ChatMemory
@Component public class RouxChatMemory extends Object implements org.springframework.ai.chat.memory.ChatMemory
The RouxChatMemory stores Spring chat messages by calling RouxEngine. The full history is stored. A window is applied when a caller reads. add(String, List) maps each message, counts its tokens, and appends it. closeConversation(String) asks the engine to close the region. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#RouxChatMemory roux-design.md

    • add

      public void add(String conversationId, List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> messages)
      The method appends each Spring message. A null conversation id returns without writing. A null list returns without writing. A null message inside the list is skipped. Every message in one call shares one timestamp.
      Specified by:
      add in interface org.springframework.ai.chat.memory.ChatMemory
      Parameters:
      conversationId - The conversation id is the region name.
      messages - The messages are the Spring chat messages to store.

    • getWindow

      public List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> getWindow(String conversationId, int maxNonSystem, boolean pinSystem)
      The method returns a window with no token cap. A maxNonSystem of 0 or less means every non-system message.
      Parameters:
      conversationId - The conversation id is the region name.
      maxNonSystem - The cap is the maximum number of non-system messages.
      pinSystem - The flag is true when system messages stay in front.
      Returns:
      The list is the selected messages.

    • getWindow

      public List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> getWindow(String conversationId, int maxNonSystem, boolean pinSystem, int maxTokens)
      The method returns a window limited by message count and token count. A token cap of 0 or less means no token limit.
      Parameters:
      conversationId - The conversation id is the region name.
      maxNonSystem - The cap is the maximum number of non-system messages.
      pinSystem - The flag is true when system messages stay in front.
      maxTokens - The cap is the token budget, or 0 for no token limit.
      Returns:
      The list is the selected messages.

      public RouxEngine.SinkCut selectTape(String conversationId, int managedTokens, int liveTokens)
      The method asks the engine to choose which messages fit a token allowance. A null conversation id returns null.
      Parameters:
      conversationId - The conversation id is the region name.
      managedTokens - The allowance is the token budget.
      liveTokens - The live count is the token count of the unsent line.

      The cut is the selection, or null when no selection is made.

    • sinkMessages

      public List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> sinkMessages(String conversationId, RouxEngine.SinkCut cut)
      The method reads the stored messages named by a cut. The messages stay in the cut's order. An ordinal that is not a stored message is skipped. A null conversation id returns an empty list. A null cut returns an empty list.
      Parameters:
      conversationId - The conversation id is the region name.
      cut - The cut is the selection from the engine.
      Returns:
      The list is the stored messages in that order.

    • getByTokenBudget

      public List<org.springframework.ai.chat.messages.Message> getByTokenBudget(String conversationId, int maxNonSystem, boolean pinSystem, int maxTokens)
      The method reads the window the engine selects. A null conversation id returns an empty list. A frame that cannot be decoded is skipped.
      Parameters:
      conversationId - The conversation id is the region name.
      maxNonSystem - The cap is the maximum number of non-system messages.
      pinSystem - The flag is true when system messages stay in front.
      maxTokens - The cap is the token budget, or 0 for no token limit.
      Returns:
      The list is the selected messages.

    • checkpoint

      public void checkpoint(String conversationId)
      The method asks the engine to publish the hot page. A null conversation id returns without a change. The engine returns at once when the pack is off, the process is memory-only, or the durability is hot-only.
      Parameters:
      conversationId - The conversation id is the region name.

    • inspectById

      public MessageInspect inspectById(String conversationId, long hi, long lo)
      The method finds a message by its two identity longs and returns the inspect view. A sequence number below 1 returns null.
      Parameters:
      conversationId - The conversation id is the region name.
      hi - The high long is the first 64 bits of the identity.
      lo - The low long is the second 64 bits of the identity.
      Returns:
      The view is the inspect result, or null.

      Returns:

    • countByTypeName

      public int countByTypeName(String conversationId, String typeName)
      The method counts messages by a type name. The name SYSTEM counts the system role. The name USER counts the user role. The name ASSISTANT counts the assistant role. Any other name returns 0.
      Parameters:
      conversationId - The conversation id is the region name.
      typeName - The name is SYSTEM, USER, or ASSISTANT.
      Returns:
      The count is the number of matching messages.
